game.title: LEGO The Hobbit
game.blurb: LEGO action-adventure based on the first two Hobbit films, from Traveller's Tales (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and Warner Bros. Interactive), published by Warner Bros. Interactive, released 2014-04-08. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, Family. Chapters follow the story levels named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Story Levels: Greatest Kingdom to Out of the Frying Pan
chapters.summary: The first eight story levels: Greatest Kingdom in Middle-earth, An Unexpected Party, Azog the Defiler, Roast Mutton, The Troll Hoard, Over Hill and Under Hill, Goblin Town and Out of the Frying Pan.

chapters.title: Story Levels: Queer Lodgings to Inside Information
chapters.summary: The last eight story levels, from Queer Lodgings and Flies and Spiders to On the Doorstep and Inside Information, plus the Bonus Level. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Middle-earth, Collectibles and Treasure
chapters.summary: Quests in Middle-earth, Mithril Bricks, Schematics, Treasure Items, Minikits, every character, forging Mithril treasures, studs, Master Burglar titles, loot and the mining game.

chapters.title: Characters and Abilities
chapters.summary: Buddy-Up attacks, Gandalf's startle, Beorn's bear form, Mithril outfits and a custom character.

chapters.title: Co-op and 100%
chapters.summary: Playing a level in co-op and reaching 100% completion.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/LEGO_The_Hobbit

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3729). Steam app 285160 ("LEGO® The Hobbit™" in the store list, "LEGO - The Hobbit" in the schema) was used. StrategyWiki has a page (completion stage 0): only the main page and its Table of Contents are written; every subpage it links (Walkthrough, the 16 level pages, Bonus Level, Characters, Mithril Bricks and the rest) is not written, so it was not used. The level names and order here come from the Steam achievements (COMPLETE_STORYEVENT1 to 16), which match the level names the StrategyWiki contents page links. lego.fandom.com answers the API under "LEGO The Hobbit" with about 105 linked articles (mostly character names); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 39 Steam achievements is hidden. Eight list "(Single Player Only)". "Collect all characters" sits with the collectibles.
